senses.gloss: to tilt, pour out slowly (so as to leave the sediment behind).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:14">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 12</cite> <he>כדקים … שׁוֹפִין אלו באלו</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <cite ref="U00504"><he>שופכין</he></cite>) as the small bowels of an animal that pour their contents from one to the other.
Esth. R. to II, 3; a. e.—Esp. to sell wine.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60a:10">B. Mets. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>השׁוֹפֶה יין לחמרים</he> Ms. H. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10; ed. <he>לחבירו</he>; Ar. <he>לשמרים</he>, corr. acc.) if one sells wine to ass-drivers (caravan at an inn); Tosef. ib. III, 27 <he>היה שׁוֹפֵא וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="U00493"><he>שופה</he></cite>); a. e.

senses.gloss: to make slanting, whittle to a point.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּפֶּה; f. מְשׁוּפָּה; pl. מְשׁוּפִּים, מְשׁוּפִּין; מְשׁוּפּוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 5b:2">Keth. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>מש׳ כיתדות</he> (the fingers) pointed like pegs.
